2607.29065.title: Tokenizer-Agnostic Engram Module
2607.29065.paper_summary: Deepseek's Engram, a conditional memory module, was introduced to trade-off storage versus reasoning in large language models. However, the module relies on token-level $N$-gram hashing for Engram embedding lookup, introducing a tight coupling to the tokenizer used: a model with a different tokenizer would have to train its own Engram embeddings from scratch. To improve the reusability of Engram embeddings, we propose a change to the hashing routine, enabling compatibility between Engram models using different tokenizers. Instead of modelling disjoint $N$-gram spaces, we treat $N$-gram as a method to sample potentially useful byte sequences, from all possible byte sequences across tokens. We replace the XOR-based hashing with the general polynomial hashing with a joint embedding space across $N$. This work investigates the possible trade-offs and shows that this simple substitution produces comparable performance and achieves tokenizer-agnosticism: hash equivalence for byte-equivalent token sequences.
2607.29065.paper_summary_zh: Deepseek 的 Engram，一種條件記憶模組，被引入來在大型語言模型中權衡儲存與推理之間的取捨。<lb/>然而，該模組依賴於基於標記的 $N$-gram 哈希來查找 Engram 嵌入，這使其與所使用的標記器緊密耦合：使用不同標記器的模型必須從頭開始訓練自己的 Engram 嵌入。<lb/>為了提高 Engram 嵌入的可重用性，我們提出了一種對哈希例程的改變，使得使用不同標記器的 Engram 模型之間能夠兼容。<lb/>我們不再建模不相交的 $N$-gram 空間，而是將 $N$-gram 視為一種從所有可能的標記字節序列中抽樣潛在有用字節序列的方法。<lb/>我們用一般的多項式哈希取代基於 XOR 的哈希，並在 $N$ 上建立一個聯合嵌入空間。<lb/>這項工作探討了可能的取捨，並顯示這一簡單的替代方案產生了可比的性能，並實現了與標記器無關性：對於字節等價的標記序列的哈希等價性。
